description: Add a support email address. Summer creates its private forwarding address and signing key and returns the DNS record to add. The address starts off; nothing is sent.

display_name.description: Sender name customers see on replies.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key when retrying the same change

installation_id.description: Messenger installation whose inbox the emails join. Defaults to the first installation.

support_address.description: The address customers already write to, such as support@example.com.

name: summer_messenger_email_create
title: Add a support email address
